questions.prompt: They did not cease to fight until the leader of the enemy fell.
questions.answer: Nōn prius pugnāre dēstitērunt quam dux hostium cecidit.

questions.prompt: The merchant did not return home before he had sold all his goods.
questions.answer: Mercātor nōn ante domum rediit quam omnēs mercēs vēndidit.

questions.prompt: They could not cross the river before the bridge was completed by the workmen.
questions.answer: Nōn prius flūmen trānsīre potuērunt quam pōns ā fabrīs perfectus est.
